overview: The Medford School Committee elected its officers for 2019, reviewed administrative updates on English language learners, kindergarten registration, and facility heating, and tabled a payroll report pending further data. The committee also voted to refer student obesity screening data to a Committee of the Whole and entered executive session for negotiations.

items.title: Election of 2019 Officers
items.summary: Kathy Kreatz was elected Vice Chair and Mea Mustone was elected Secretary for calendar year 2019.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Bills
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the January 7, 2019 meeting and approved bills and fund transfers.

items.title: Payroll Report
items.summary: Tabled the quarterly payroll report after committee members requested additional information, including job titles and department locations.

items.title: Committee and Secretary Reports
items.summary: Accepted and placed on file the report of outgoing secretary Kathy Kreatz, the Rules Subcommittee report, and the Committee of the Whole report on the McGlynn trauma assessment.

items.title: Superintendent's Update
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent reported on state education funding advocacy, an upcoming vaping workshop, robotics curriculum expansion, Priscilla's Pantry, and a distracted driving presentation.

items.title: Kindergarten Registration
items.summary: Approved the 2019–2020 kindergarten registration packet and schedule of Building Bridges sessions for web publication with suggested clarifications.

items.title: Medford High School Science Enrichment Trip
items.summary: Approved a high school science and leadership enrichment trip to the Disney Youth Education Series in April 2020.

items.title: English Language Learners Report
items.summary: Accepted an ELL department report noting that the district has cleared state corrective action and presenting student demographic and ACCESS testing data.

items.title: Student Growth and Obesity Report
items.summary: Referred student screening and obesity data to the Committee of the Whole to investigate district health and nutrition policies.

items.title: Attorney General PTO Webinar and Nonprofit Registration
items.summary: Accepted an informational report regarding an upcoming state Attorney General webinar for nonprofit board members and the local registration deadline for school-affiliated support groups.

items.title: High School Heating System Update
items.summary: Accepted a facilities report detailing recent heating coil repairs in the auditorium and recurring pipe maintenance in the vocational school.

items.title: Condolence Resolution and Executive Session
items.summary: Adopted a resolution of condolence for Florence DeMartino and voted to enter executive session to discuss negotiations and legal matters.
